reason: Adds a web UI status line that monitors DeepSeek session cost, token usage, burn rate, peak pricing status, current model, and account balance using local session data and configured API-backed requests.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示会话成本、令牌用量、消耗速率、峰谷时段、当前模型和账户余额状态。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek session cost, token usage, burn rate, peak-period status, current model, and account balance in the Harness web interface.

capabilities: Reads the configured DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to request account balance data
Calls DeepSeek balance and external exchange-rate endpoints
Executes curl.exe through subprocess for network requests
Tracks session token usage and calculates displayed cost and burn rate
Serves usage data through a local web route and renders a status line in the web UI
